models.purpose: Suggest the preparation, plating, sides, surface and accent options (and the combined plating check in Express mode) from the knowledge base
Write the scene story and label texts, and check it for cultural accuracy
Render each element's prompt segment as a three-view turnaround (profile, 30° down, top down) on white to check food detail
Draw the picked layout as a detailed black-and-white pencil sketch of the finished scene, through the photo's camera, on Sketch review
Generate the final scene from the layout proxy and the story's prompt segments on the Story & image step, and preview individual elements in the node workspace
